cleared.where: not separately observed: the system weakened inland instead of a rear clearing the coast, the alternative the tools README allows. National Bulletin No. 42 (BOB/10/2026), 01:15 IST on 21 November, based on the 23:30 observation of the 20th, declared itself the last update for Akvan and carried no latitude or longitude; the remnant was a low pressure area over north Chhattisgarh and neighbourhood by 05:30 on 21 November, having carried no position since 20.2N 84.9E at 17:30 on 20 November
